how_to_verify: Remove the fields digest, ed25519, internal_hmac_sha256, signature.
Serialize the rest as JSON with keys sorted at every level, separators ',' and ':', no whitespace, non-ASCII escaped as \uXXXX, UTF-8.
sha256 of those bytes must equal 'digest'.
ed25519.sig_hex must verify over those same bytes with public_key_hex, and public_key_hex must equal the key published here.
scope: A valid signature shows this record was issued by the btc402 service key and has not been changed since. It is not an on-chain ERC-8004 registry entry, not an external timestamp and not a third-party audit. Records issued before 2026-11-08 carry only an internal HMAC and cannot be verified with this key.
